text:
Happy Veterans Day to all the brave men and women who have served our great country.

“Thank you for your service” should be said often every day, especially today.

Fighting for those who have given so much to defend our country is one of the most important responsibilities entrusted to Congress, and we must prioritize legislation that lives up to our commitment to veterans.

Earlier this year, I introduced the Veterans Housing Opportunity Act to help address veteran homelessness by allowing HUD and the VA to repurpose unused veteran housing assistance vouchers to communities where the need is greatest. Thanks to input from the Tunnels to Towers Foundation, I’m confident we will deliver this important reform to veterans in need of safe and stable housing.

Our office remains committed to serving veterans across Pennsylvania’s 9th Congressional District by fighting for the care, benefits, and support they have earned. To every veteran who has worn our nation’s uniform, thank you for your courage, sacrifice, and dedication to our country.

May God bless our veterans, their families, and the United States of America.
